notes: Three taḥwīl branches; «كلهم عن هشام، في هذا الإسناد» is written once after the last branch and belongs to all three (rule 3).

The text has no matn: «وحدثناه» points to the preceding report, which is not in this text and no previous report is supplied, so no saying or route is inherited. «وليس في حديثهم غسل الرجلين» is a wording remark: left out.
